written: before any measurement; applied by scripts/rule.ts; exercised on invented numbers by scripts/rule-toy.ts
roadmap_rule: Pick the faster one that passes the fragmentation suite on both builds.

canary.if_not_obtainable: Not verified here; the verdict covers release only

fragmentation.also_requires: in scenarios flagged must_observe (every planned cut separated by at least 1 ms), every planned cut is observed as a delivery boundary at the adapter (the scenario is effective); in the others the effect is reported

capability_definitions.tls_upgrade: after SSLRequest answered S on an open socket, a TLS handshake against a node:tls server succeeds, protocol bytes round-trip, and a hostname mismatch fails
capability_definitions.pause_resume_bounded: server pushes a 256 MiB stream; client pauses reads for 2000 ms; at most 1 MiB is delivered after a 100 ms settle, client RSS grows by at most 64 MiB during the window, and after resume every byte arrives with the right hash
capability_definitions.write_backpressure: one 64 MiB write against a server that stops reading for 1000 ms: the API signals backpressure (false return or partial write) and a drain signal arrives after the server resumes; all bytes arrive with the right hash
capability_definitions.terminal_once: after server RST, server FIN inside a message and local destroy, the adapter surfaces exactly one terminal event and no data event after it

suite_sanity.else: suite is defective and no verdict is issued

throughput.metric: operations or MB per second, higher is better, median of runs

noise.null_spread: relative gap |m1-m2| / mean(m1,m2) between the medians of two interleaved series of the same candidate; the larger of the two candidates' gaps per cell

faster.x_faster_than_y: X wins at least one cell and loses none

pick.pool: candidates in candidates_in_rule that pass the gate on every build run
pick.two_in_pool: the faster on the release build; if neither is faster (mixed, or all within noise) take tie_order
pick.tie_order_note: planner's choice: the Node transport (P6-T01) must exist anyway

failed_build_or_candidate: reported as failed; no threshold is moved
